intro: The Encrypted Sigil is a coded token delivered to newly awakened night elf rogues in Shadowglen. Bearing hidden instructions from the trainer Frahun Shadewhisper, it directs fledgling operatives to initiate their training amidst growing threats to Teldrassil.

p: Within the sheltered hollow of Shadowglen, emerging night elf scouts and infiltrators are contacted through discreet means. The Encrypted Sigil is passed directly into an initiate's hands by a quiet messenger on behalf of Frahun Shadewhisper. Concealing its contents in a manner fitting the profession, the sigil instructs the recipient to report to Frahun near Aldrassil. To Shadewhisper, reading and delivering the token proves an initiate can follow subtle directives and handle covert missives.

Frahun uses the summons to stress the necessity of rogues in an unsettled world. With tensions simmering between the night elves and the distant Horde, Shadewhisper reminds his recruits that open warfare is not the only peril facing their people. Rogues must serve as the early eyes and unseen blades of the Kaldorei, gathering intelligence across Teldrassil and learning to strike before threats can take root in the boughs of the World Tree.
